title: Linked docs error categories to concrete changelog fixes
points: The public docs now link the error-to-fix explanation to specific changelog entries for ticker grounding, source corpus gaps, data-quality warnings, deterministic compute, and answer synthesis.
Changelog entries now carry stable IDs into the generated frontend data so docs can link directly to one change instead of only opening the changelog tab.
The query-engine docs now make the repair loop navigable: users can move from an error category to the exact public fix that shows how that class of issue was addressed.
